scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@creatorpilot/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@creatorpilot/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/backend && npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace=@creatorpilot/backend" "npm run start --workspace=@creatorpilot/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@creatorpilot/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@creatorpilot/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@creatorpilot/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@creatorpilot/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@creatorpilot/backend && npm run test --workspace=@creatorpilot/frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md
